description: This file defines the ExternalAuthenticationsController class, which manages external login and registration workflows in an ASP.NET Core application, including login, linking external accounts, and handling external login callbacks.

classes.name: ExternalAuthenticationsController
classes.description: Controller handling external login, registration, linking, and callback processes for external authentication providers.

methods.name: ExternalLogin
methods.description: Initiates external login by redirecting to the provider.

methods.name: ExternalLoginCallback
methods.description: Handles the callback from external provider, manages user linking or registration.

methods.name: RegisterExternalLogin
methods.description: Registers a new user via external login with provided form data.

methods.name: LinkExternalLogin
methods.description: Links an external login to an existing user account.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Starts the process to link an external login to current user.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Completes linking external login to user account.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes an external login from the user account.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays current external logins associated with the user.

methods.name: GenerateUsernameAsync
methods.description: Generates a username based on external login info and handlers.

methods.name: ExternalSignInAsync
methods.description: Performs sign-in process using external login info, updates user properties, and tokens.

methods.name: UpdateAndValidatePasswordAsync
methods.description: Validates and updates password fields based on settings.

methods.name: UpdateAndValidateUserNameAsync
methods.description: Validates and sets username based on external info and settings.

methods.name: UpdateAndValidateEmail
methods.description: Validates and sets email based on external info and settings.

methods.name: AddErrorsToModelState
methods.description: Adds identity errors to the model state.

methods.name: RedirectToLogin
methods.description: Redirects to login page, optionally copying model errors.

methods.name: CopyModelStateErrorsToTempData
methods.description: Copies model state errors to TempData for display.
